parameters.content:
## Make UGC video ads with a consistent AI presenter and voice

📖 **Full walkthrough:** [How to Make UGC Video Ads in n8n with the Google Flow API](https://useapi.net/docs/articles/google-flow-n8n-ugc-ads?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ugc-ad-factory)

**Who it's for:** anyone making short UGC-style video ads: store owners, agencies, creators. It runs on **your own Google Flow account** (a paid Google AI plan) through the [useapi.net](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ugc-ad-factory) API, with Omni 1.1 Flash for video.

**How it works.** Open the form. Choose 1 to 5 products, an optional intro and closing clip, the format and the takes per clip. Then each page shows results so you can pick one or re-roll:
1. A presenter (generate 4, upload photos, or reuse a saved character), a second angle, and 4 voice previews. Face and voice become one character.
2. A four-view sheet per product, or your own product photo.
3. A scene with the presenter and every product. It shows the credit cost before anything is paid.
4. One clip per product plus the intro and closing, N takes each, filmed in that scene with the picked voice. Pick a take per clip, or edit and re-roll.
5. Optional 1080p upscale; the last page plays the joined ad, links the MP4, and shows the character ID for your next ad.

**Errors.** Captcha and temporary Google errors are retried automatically. Content refusals ask you to change the action. Account or token problems stop with a page that says what to fix.

**Setup**
- A [useapi.net](https://useapi.net/docs/subscription?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ugc-ad-factory) subscription and API token, and a Google Flow account connected to it on a paid Google AI plan.
- In n8n, create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <your API token>`, and select it on every HTTP Request node.
- Activate the workflow and open the **Start form** URL.

**Cost.** Images, voices, the character, upscaling and joining are free. Each Omni take costs 7, 10, 12 or 15 Flow credits for 4, 6, 8 or 10 s. The default ad (intro + 1 product + closing, 4 takes) is about 140 credits.

**Customize.** The defaults live in **Settings**, which also holds the image model and the captcha attempts.

### 1. Setup, details and uploads
The first page asks for counts only; **Settings** builds a details page with exactly those fields. Photos uploaded there go to your Flow account first.

### 2. Presenter
Four candidates from the description. Re-roll with a note until one fits. Skipped when you upload photos or reuse a character.

### 3. Second angle
A three-quarter view of the same face, from the generated presenter or a single uploaded photo.

### 4. Voice and character
Four preset voices read your sample line; pick one or hear four more. Face and voice are saved as one character.

### 5. Product images
Four four-view sheets per product, or your photo as is. Re-roll any single product; the others keep their picks.

### 6. Scene
The presenter and every product in one frame, four candidates, with the credit cost of the clips shown before you continue.

### 7. Clips
Omni 1.1 Flash in reference mode: character, voice, scene and the clip's product, N takes per clip. Polled every 20 s.

### 8. Upscale and final page
Optional free 1080p upscale. The last page plays the joined ad and shows the character ID to reuse.

### 9. Download ad (second entry point)
The player and the download link on the last page call this webhook. It joins the picked clips for free and streams the MP4; nothing is stored.
